integrity.proof_basis: Affine conjugacy, a finite-field sum-of-squares identity, and an analytic induction on return iterates.

scientific_limitations: The result is local to B = 1/2 + p Z_p and does not classify the dynamics on its complement.
The proof requires p >= 5; p = 2 and p = 3 are not covered.
The minimality consequence follows from established general ergodicity theory; the specific claim is the exact return-shift congruence.
The literature comparison is bounded and does not prove absolute uniqueness; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact return-shift law for ramified quadratic p-adic maps
